text:
Alyssa (CS): quick heads-up — CipherLane onboarding: p95 latency jumped from ~450ms to ~2.75s after they started longer docs. AM flagged renewal risk. I want to propose a short canary: int8 quantized model + split routing (hot low-latency path for short responses, cost path for long generations). ok to run asap? :warning:
Mike (ENG): can you paste the burst logs/seq len distro? we should try KV prefix caching first if majority are short prefixes. also need a rollback plan.
Alyssa (CS): attaching snippets below. most requests are 1–3k tokens but tail to 10k. KV cache helps some, but CPU bound during long tail.
Jordan (ML): int8 is reasonable for their distro. quality drop expected ~1–3% on exact-match tests for our eval set, but p95 improvement ~250–350ms and cost down ~35–45% from preliminary sims. recommend two-phase: (1) llm-int8 canary at 5% traffic + eval harness on 500 golden prompts, (2) split routing with 1% sticky to low-latency model for priority routes.
Mike (ENG): agree. need a canary config, healthchecks, and an automatic fallback to baseline model on >1% error increase. will set alerts for latency and error rate.
Jordan (ML): suggested canary snippet (for ops runbook):
```json
{
  "canary_pct": 5,
  "routes": ["/api/v1/generate_short","/api/v1/generate_long"],
  "model_map": {"/api/v1/generate_short": "redwood/llama-70b-int8", "/api/v1/generate_long": "redwood/llama-70b"},
  "eval_set": "gs://cipherlane/evals/500_short_and_mixed.json",
  "quality_threshold": "delta_exact_match <= 0.03"
}
```
Sam (Success): Olivia, CipherLane team — would 11:00–13:00 PT today work for a low-risk canary window? we'll monitor and roll back immediately if anything odd. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Olivia - CipherLane: 11–13 PT is fine. main concern is hallucination spikes — we can't have user-visible nonsense. we'll accept a brief canary as long as you cut traffic quickly on alerts.
Mike (ENG): ops command I'll run (copy/paste):
```
redwood deploy canary --thread 1719876543 --canary-config /deploy/configs/cipherlane-canary.json --timeout 2h
```
I'll create the canary config from Jordan's snippet and wire alerts: p95 > 1s OR token-error-rate +10% -> auto rollback.
deploy-bot: Canary scheduled by Mike (ENG) — id canary-1719 — start 2026-03-21T18:00:00Z (ETA 30min).
Jordan (ML): I'll kick off the eval harness once canary has 200 samples. compare latency, exact match, and ROUGE/BLEU-ish metrics. I'll post a short diff.
Alyssa (CS): action items: (1) Mike — deploy canary + alerts, (2) Jordan — eval harness + quality gate, (3) Sam — communicate cadence/backstop to CipherLane AMs, (4) Olivia — flag any user complaints immediately. I'll follow up in 30m with scoreboard. :white_check_mark:
Olivia - CipherLane: thanks — appreciate the proactive approach. if this shaves costs and keeps UX, renewals much easier.
Mike (ENG): starting canary now. ping here when you see anomalies.
deploy-bot: Canary canary-1719 started — routing 5% traffic to redwood/llama-70b-int8. Monitoring hooks: latency.p95, model.error_rate, hallucination_detector.alerts.
Alyssa (CS): noted. will close loop after initial 2h window.
Sam (Success): I'll schedule a 30m debrief at 14:30 PT to review results with CipherLane and AMs. invite sent.
